title: Senior Product Manager
description:
**About LJI** 




 Loyalty Juggernaut (LJI) is a leading B2B SaaS company redefining how enterprises drive customer engagement and loyalty. Our flagship platform, GRAVTY®, enables global brands to transform loyalty programs into measurable, revenue\-generating growth engines.
 



 Built as an AI\-first, next\-generation solution, GRAVTY® empowers organizations to deliver highly personalized, real\-time experiences at scale—helping them increase customer lifetime value and deepen brand relationships.
 



 Headquartered in Palo Alto, California, LJI partners with leading enterprises across 16 major industries including airlines, retail, hospitality, financial services and telecommunications powering some of the most innovative loyalty ecosystems worldwide.
 



  





**Our Global Impact:** 



* 400\+ Million members connected through our platform.
* 100\+ Global Brands trust us to drive loyalty and brand devotion.
* 3\-Time Winner of “Best Technology Innovation in Loyalty”.
* Global recognitions for Excellence in Loyalty Management under numerous categories.
* Recognised as a ‘Strong performer’ in The Forrester Wave™ Loyalty Platforms, Q4 2025\.



  





 Explore more about us at www.lji.io
 



  





**The Opportunity:** 




 We’re looking for a strategic and execution\-focused Senior Product Manager to lead the vision, strategy, and delivery of intelligent, scalable product experiences. In this role, you will own the product vision, shape the platform strategy, and drive meaningful business impact. From uncovering customer insights to launching and scaling adoption, you will lead the roadmap end\-to\-end — defining priorities, making critical trade\-offs, and delivering outcomes that matter. Working at the intersection of Engineering, Design, AI, and Go\-to\-Market teams, you will build intelligent, scalable product experiences that redefine how enterprises engage, operate, and grow.
 



  





**What You’ll Do** 



* Develop a strong understanding of customer needs, market trends, and competitive landscapes, and translate insights into a strategic product roadmap.
* Own the complete product lifecycle, including product discovery, requirement definition, execution, launch, adoption, and continuous enhancement.
* Drive the development of AI\-first product capabilities and user experiences that transform how enterprises manage and optimize loyalty programs.
* Collaborate closely with Engineering, QA, UX, AI/ML, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success teams to ensure seamless product delivery and business alignment.
* Create and maintain clear product documentation including PRDs, user stories, business cases, GTM plans, release documentation, and success metrics.
* Monitor product performance using data and analytics to improve customer adoption, engagement, retention, and overall business impact.
* Mentor and support Product Managers within the team, fostering strong product thinking, accountability, and execution excellence.



  





**What You Bring** 



* 4–6 years of Product Management experience in technology or SaaS organizations, with proven ownership of products across the complete lifecycle.
* Hands\-on experience building and delivering AI\-powered product features leveraging LLMs, AI agents, automation workflows, or applied Machine Learning solutions in production environments.
* 2–3 years of experience leading cross\-functional teams and mentoring Product Managers, with the ability to drive alignment and execution across multiple stakeholders.
* A track record of successfully launching products or features that delivered measurable customer and business impact.
* Strong understanding of Agile methodologies, product delivery frameworks, and modern SaaS product management practices.
* Proficiency with product design and collaboration tools such as Figma, Adobe XD, or equivalent platforms.
* Excellent documentation and communication skills, with experience creating PRDs, user stories, functional specifications, release notes, and other product artifacts.
* Strong blend of strategic thinking, customer empathy, and data\-driven decision\-making
* MBA from a premier B\-School is a MUST, preferably with a specialization in Marketing, Strategy, or Product Management. Engineering degree in Computer Science or related disciplines is preferred.



  





**Why Join Us** 



* Be part of a fast\-growing global organization recognized for innovation and customer success
* Gain strategic exposure and play a key role in defining the future direction of our platform
* Drive measurable impact by shaping products that solve real enterprise challenges
* Partner with exceptional talent across Product, Engineering, AI, Design, and Go\-to\-Market teams
* Thrive in a collaborative, high\-trust environment that values learning, ownership, and innovation

 Product Manager
   

  

**Location:** 
 Hyderabad, India

 Director of Product Management, JAI
   

  

**Type:** 
 Full\-Time
   

  

**About The Role**
 This role owns JAGGAER's analytics and data products: the analytics and business intelligence suite, Bulk Data Export, and the next generation of data products we build for customers. These are established, revenue\-generating capabilities with live commitments across the customer base, and they are being reshaped by AI faster than any other part of the platform.
   

  

 The mandate is to define and deliver what those products become in an AI\-first platform. That means insight that finds the customer rather than waiting to be asked for, including generated insight and anomaly detection across their spend. It means data products built for a customer's own systems and agents to consume, not only for a person to read. And it means owning the trust layer underneath all of it, so that the answers our AI produces are accurate enough to put in front of a procurement executive.
   

  

 You will work across the JAI portfolio, because the data and intelligence layer you own is what every agent and research capability in the product reasons over.
   

  

 This is a strategy and delivery role in a single seat. You will set the direction, and you will be measured on what ships against it.
   

  

**Principal Responsibilities**
* Product ownership: Own the strategy, roadmap and delivery for the analytics and business intelligence suite, Bulk Data Export, and the data products built on them.
* AI\-native insight capabilities: Define and deliver new AI capabilities in this space, including generated insight and anomaly detection across customer spend, taking them from concept through early access to general availability.
* Product direction: Define what analytics and data products become as AI absorbs them, including how customers consume data when their own systems and agents are the consumer rather than a person, and where the boundary sits between surfacing an insight and acting on it. Establish the product direction for agent\-ready data delivery.
* Data trust and accuracy: Own the quality bar for the data and semantic models our AI reasons over: the definitions of core procurement measures, the evaluation approach that proves accuracy, and the standard a model must meet before it is used with a customer.
* Committed delivery: Meet the existing analytics, reporting and data export commitments already sold to customers, including those carried in active RFPs and renewals, and keep the install base on a clear roadmap.
* Cross\-functional collaboration: Work closely with engineering, applied AI, UX, and the Experience, AgentOS and Deep Research product managers, so the data and intelligence layer serves the whole JAI portfolio rather than one surface.
* Market and customer insight: Validate problems and proposed capabilities directly with customers and prospects, and use that evidence to prioritise. Support analytics and data content in RFPs and executive briefings.
* Agile execution: Translate product requirements into clear, well\-defined requirements and acceptance criteria for the engineering teams, and work with them through delivery.
* Metrics and performance: Define and report the KPIs for this scope, including adoption of the AI insight surfaces, accuracy against the evaluation set, and delivery against customer commitments.


**Position Requirements**
**What You Will Bring**
* 3\+ years of product management experience in SaaS or enterprise software, including ownership of a product area end to end.
* Hands\-on experience with AI products, including LLM\-powered applications, prompt engineering, retrieval architectures, or applying AI to structured enterprise data.
* Strong working understanding of data platforms, semantic and dimensional modelling, and analytics or BI tooling. Snowflake experience is an advantage.
* A rigorous approach to accuracy: comfort defining ground truth, designing evaluation sets, and holding a quality bar under delivery pressure.
* Experience working with enterprise customers to validate problems and quantify value, rather than gathering feature requests.
* Experience with procurement, source\-to\-pay, supply chain or finance data is an advantage.
* Proficiency in Agile methodologies and working closely with distributed engineering teams.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business, or a related field preferred.


**Success in This Position**
* An outcome focus, with customer value always in mind.
* Comfortable saying no to a capability that has not met the accuracy bar, and able to explain that decision commercially to sales and to customers.
* Able to hold both a multi\-year product direction and a current\-quarter delivery commitment without losing either.
* Strong written and verbal communication in English, and credible with both engineering and business leadership.
* Effective at influencing without authority across product, engineering and go\-to\-market teams.
* Accustomed to working in an international environment across multiple development sites and time zones.


**Goals for the First 12 Months**
* An agreed product direction for analytics and data products in an AI\-first platform, signed off with Product and Engineering leadership and reflected in the roadmap.
* Generated insight and anomaly detection delivered to early access customers, with adoption and accuracy reported as the primary measures of success.
* A published quality and evaluation standard for the data and semantic models our AI reasons over, with accuracy tracked and reported.
* All existing analytics, reporting and data export commitments met, with a clear and communicated roadmap for the install base.
* Customer validation of the new AI capabilities in this space, with quantified outcomes suitable for use in renewals and new business.


**What We Offer**
 At JAGGAER, we are committed to supporting you and your family’s well\-being. Your health is a priority, and we offer a range of programs to help you stay well and thrive. Our benefits include Health, Accidental Insurance, and Term Life.
   

  

**Our Values \- T.E.A.M**
 At JAGGAER, our business is about people. **Description**
 Amazon moves millions of packages every day through the world's largest transportation network of planes, trucks, and delivery vehicles. Before any package can be assigned to a route, someone needs to design that network \- figure out which lanes exist, how much capacity each node and lane can handle, and what changes are needed as demand shifts. That's what we build.
   

  

 Global Transportation Tech Services (GTTS) creates software that manages the foundation of Amazon's outbound transportation network. Your work has direct financial impact on network efficiency and directly affects whether customers get their packages on time.
   

  

 Here's what we actually do: We build the platform that transportation teams use to design and change the network \- from evaluating new lanes to implementing them in production. We calculate how much capacity each node and lane will have, so the network can handle the volume. We identify where capacity will fall short and alert operators before it becomes a problem. We spot packages at risk of missing delivery and give operators tools to protect them. When a hurricane hits Florida or a snowstorm shuts down highways in Germany, our systems detect the disruption, protect customers by adjusting delivery promises, and help move volume to keep packages flowing.
   

  

 The challenges are real: modeling capacity across a massive global network, managing thousands of network changes safely, predicting capacity gaps weeks in advance, detecting and responding to disruptions in real\-time, and keeping systems running 24/7\.
   

  

 We regularly build new greenfield products while also modernizing existing systems. You'll have space to explore new technologies and approaches to solve customer problems. We work with AWS services, big data processing (Spark/Scala), optimization algorithms, machine learning models, and GenAI.

 AI\-native products or features that users love · Enterprise software with AI capabilities built in (not tacked on) · Products that required deep LLM integration and cost optimization · Cross\-functional initiatives that span multiple teams or product areas · Experiences that balance power with usability.

**Description**
 Amazon’s Ship Tech (STS) team is responsible for key technology that enables planning, orchestration, and execution of transportation service to deliver billions of packages to Amazon.com customer globally. Our goal is to ensure the best delivery experience for customers across all geographies through a highly scalable, adaptive, and autonomous transportation network.
   

  

 We are looking for a product leader to own and drive our technical roadmap for key systems and capabilities that enable Customer Delivery Experience and Cost to Serve Reductions. They will own critical Amazon services that leverage real\-time insights and predictive supply chain data across our entire network to drive automation, efficiency, and visibility. These services allow us to identify problems that could impact on\-time delivery, take proactive actions to mitigate network and package level problems, and keep customers informed on what is happening.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is capable of breaking down and solving complex problems, and has a strong will to get things done! You will work on real world problems on a global scale. You own your products end\-to\-end and influence the direction of our product and technology which impacts hundreds\-of\-millions of customers around the world. You are a hands\-on, pragmatic problem solver that easily balances trade\-offs between competing interests. You thrive in a fast\-moving team environment where you are able to juggle complex dependencies and requirements while producing optimal solutions.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will have successfully built 0\-to\-1 products in the logistics and transportation space. You are able to synthesize a variety of technologies and capabilities, and translate them into products that solve specific pain\-points. You are analytical and data driven, and are laser focused on measuring and improving the success of products you own. You will own the business model, P\&L, feature development, product roadmap, customer segmentation and pricing, and demand generation. You will drive product development across multiple cross\-functional teams.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Serve as the subject matter expert in transportation visibility and intelligence, leveraging your deep domain knowledge to identify market trends, customer pain points, and opportunities for product enhancement
   

  

 Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including engineering, design, and customer success, to translate business requirements into technical specifications and drive the successful implementation of new product features and enhancements
   

  

 Develop a comprehensive product roadmap that aligns with the company's overall strategic objectives and effectively communicates it to stakeholders
   

  

 Continuously gather and analyze customer feedback, market intelligence, and industry insights to inform product decisions and ensure the delivery of high\-value solutions
   

  

 Champion a customer\-centric design approach, working closely with Operational, Business, and UX team to optimize the user experience and drive product adoption
   

  

 Manage the product lifecycle, from ideation to launch, ensuring that milestones are met, risks are mitigated, and the product is delivered on time and within budget

* 5\+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders
* Experience overseeing roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience in using statistical analysis to identify issues or opportunities for improvement
